name: Run PBT Suite & Typecheck on Engine Save
command: npm run lint && npm run test:composition && node --import tsx --input-type=module -e "import { runPbtInvariants } from './src/engine/pbtSuite.ts'; const res = runPbtInvariants(20261116, 100); console.log(res.map(r => r.id + ':' + r.passedCount + '/' + r.trials).join(', ')); if (!res.every(r => r.passed)) process.exit(1);"
description: Typechecks and tests song-to-art invariants plus all 500 existing seeded PBT trials (5 groups × 100), when engine files change.
